method.description: Hostile probes were executed TWICE against the identical probe harness: once against the unrepaired repair-base module and once against the repaired module. Each probe attempts an escape route and drives author -> registry -> the UNMODIFIED M3 seam, then inspects the emitted positive object's semantic_payload.
method.why_end_to_end: A refusal at schema authoring is recorded as a refusal, but the BEFORE runs are the important evidence: they show the same probe reaching decision_state SUPPORTED with the hostile value inside the positive object. Probes are only credited if the hostile value was observed to reach a SUPPORTED object before the repair.

probes.why_this_probe_exists: HQ211 Repair 1 requires that no caller evade the gate by hand-authoring a schema mapping. A probe that only called the constructors would not have demonstrated this.

positive_controls.target: a CLOSED governed string leaf must still author and evaluate
positive_controls.why_it_matters: Repair 1 must close the escape route WITHOUT closing lawful closed-list authoring. A repair that simply forbade all string leaves would pass every refusal probe and fail here.

positive_controls.target: a CLOSED governed exact-ref kind leaf must still author and evaluate

residual_escape_routes: None identified. The two remaining UNBOUNDED surfaces are structural cardinality (_node_array max_items and rule maximum_cardinality_or_unbounded_marker), which HQ211 Repair 1 explicitly does not abolish, and neither can carry a semantic value or kind.
